admin.title: Admin console
admin.envMissingTitle: Admin console unavailable: missing environment config
admin.envMissingDetail: Your session was recognized, but the deployment environment has neither CLERK_SECRET_KEY nor CLERK_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY, so the server cannot verify the session signature.
admin.envMissingHint: Fix: add a CLERK_SECRET_KEY environment variable for this project in the EdgeOne console (the Secret key from Clerk Dashboard → API keys; user search and role management need it too). If outbound access is restricted, configure CLERK_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY instead (the Public key from the same page, PEM format, verifies locally without JWKS fetch), then redeploy.
admin.gateSignedOutDetail: The server did not receive a login session (__session cookie). If you are already signed in, compare the client probe below — when the probe shows you as signed in, the deployment environment is dropping the session; please report this card to the maintainer.
admin.gateVerifyTitle: Admin console unavailable: session verification failed
admin.gateVerifyDetail: The server received a session token but verification failed (signature / key resolution / time window / hardening allowlist). The per-gate diagnostics below, compared with the client probe, pinpoint the failing layer.
admin.gateVerifyHintJwks: If the summary mentions JWKS / fetch failures: the deployment environment may be unable to reach the Clerk Backend API — configure CLERK_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY (Dashboard → API keys → Public key, PEM) to verify locally instead.
admin.gateVerifyHintIssuer: If the summary mentions issuer: a CLERK_ISSUER allowlist is configured — make sure it matches this instance's issuer (removing the variable disables the check).
admin.gateNotAdminDetail: The session is valid, but this account does not have the admin role (user ID: {userId}). Roles come from Clerk publicMetadata.role — ask an admin to change it, then sign in again to refresh the token.
admin.subtitle: Visible to the admin role only — access is decided by the session claims.metadata.role (injected via Clerk session token customization, signed with the JWT).
admin.policyRun: Code runs: {count} per hour for regular users
admin.policyBrowser: Browser queue: {count} steps per hour for regular users
admin.policyConfigHint: Regular-user quotas are defaults and can be overridden by deployment env vars: SANDBOX_RUN_QUOTA, SANDBOX_BROWSER_QUOTA, SANDBOX_ADMIN_ROLE.
admin.tokenHint: Role detection requires the Clerk Dashboard → Sessions → Customize session token step that injects public_metadata into the session claims metadata field; without it every user is rate-limited as a regular user.
admin.usersUnavailable: User search is unavailable — configure CLERK_SECRET_KEY in the deployment environment and retry.
admin.noQuery: Search for a user to manage roles here (written to Clerk publicMetadata.role).
